svg.title: From one graph edge to its reuse mask
svg.desc: An undirected PageRank example has thirty-two vertices with nine non-isolated vertices shown. Outer vertex eight reads property eighteen from CSR position eighteen. Positions eighteen and twenty-two touch the same property line. Their distance four produces the Full14 metadata mask 0x00002200 and record 0x00002212 with five ID bits.
svg.text: From one graph edge to its reuse mask
Vertex identity, CSR position and cache-line identity are different quantities.
All labels are the internal vertex IDs used by the CSR. The other 23 vertices are isolated.
in-neighbor rows, visited in increasing outer ID
in_ids: row 8 plus the following accesses
Full14 example: 5 ID bits + 14 metadata bits
Position j=18 happens to contain vertex 18; j=22 contains it again. A position is not a vertex ID.
Preprocessing finishes before the measured traversal. The next plate compares the two supported formats.
